overall: All 13 verified rows reach body text via their stated primary route (script for official hosts, WebFetch for Justia/LII); every generalisation succeeded. WebFetch refused most constructed Idaho-host URLs (PROVENANCE_REQUIRED; constitution ArtI/Sect22 and ircp/56 got through), so fetch-tool routes on legislature/isc are unreliable. Instruction defects: session-law filenames for split pre-1993 years (1971 → 404), IRPC grep 'RULE {n}:' misses 'RULE 8.4 MISCONDUCT', statute/constitution currency string lives only on /howcurrentisthislaw/, OCR/column layout breaks exact expect strings (46085ORD, unpublished legend), API JSON needs lenient parsing. Regex misses: 'Idaho Rule of Evidence 404(b)', 'Idaho Rules of Civil Procedure 56', chapter-form cites. iCourt blocked status not re-observed.
